raised: Not sure what to do next after finding the S&P card; doesn't know which 'where the money is held' option to pick
The top-menu 'השקעה במדד' link might have been the better way in, so the home box may have been the wrong choice
The 'מה השאלה שלכם?' form asks for numbers before the user understands anything
Unsure whether the search box understands English terms like 'S&P 500'
The 'שני חלקים בכל חיסכון' split (where it's held vs what it's invested in) confused them
The 'מאיפה להתחיל' links (קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה, קרן כספית) don't explain how they relate to S&P 500
Too many 'איפה הכסף מוחזק' cards, with names that sound alike

Unclear which fund 'invested in dollars through a fund that tracks it' means, whether to buy it yourself, and whether dollars are a risk
Doesn't understand 'חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו'
Jargon not understood: מק"מ, אג"ח, צמודה, ניהול אישי, מסלול
Doesn't understand how 'where it's held' connects to 'what it's invested in' (e.g. S&P inside קרן השתלמות or a securities account)
No plain answer to 'how do I actually invest in the S&P 500'
Nothing says whether it's risky or whether you can lose money
The home box promised cost and tax info ('כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה') but the guide page it led to shows none of that
Nothing about how much to start with or whether small monthly deposits work
Nothing on which option suits someone like them (24, salaried, no goal)
Would drop most 'איפה הכסף מוחזק' cards (children, retirement, קרן כספית מתחדשת, ניהול אישי), and מק"מ appears twice
Would drop unneeded index cards (MSCI variants, ת"א-90, government bonds) and 'מה האתר עוד לא מכסה'
Would drop the 'מה השאלה שלכם?' form from the home page first

problems.why: The reader says the home box 'להבין סוג של חיסכון' promised what-it-is, cost and tax info, but it led to a guide page that shows none of that, which matches the person's complaint that the link's promise doesn't match where it goes.
